name: exec_command
arguments: {"cmd": "$p='.release\\academic-rule-format-audit\\packet-R1.md'; $c=Get-Content -LiteralPath $p -Encoding UTF8; '--- markers ---'; $c | Select-String -SimpleMatch '执行无效原因' | ForEach-Object { $_.LineNumber.ToString() + ': ' + $_.Line.Trim() }; '--- pairings ---'; $c | Select-String -SimpleMatch '### 配对' | ForEach-Object { $_.Line.Trim() }; '--- tasks ---'; $c | Select-String -Pattern '^## 任务' | ForEach-Object { $_.Line.Trim() }; $raw=Get-Content -LiteralPath $p -Raw -Encoding UTF8; '--- dash ---'; $m=[regex]::Matches($raw,'1879(.{1})1898'); 'occurrences=' + $m.Count; $m | ForEach-Object { 'sep=U+{0:X4}' -f [int][char]$_.Groups[1].Value }; '--- counts ---'; 'article72=' + ([regex]::Matches($raw,'Article 72')).Count; 'bare72=' + ([regex]::Matches($raw,'\\*9\\*, 72\\.')).Count; 'r028=' + ([regex]::Matches($raw,'\\(r = 0\\.28\\)')).Count; '--- notes ---'; $c | Select-String -SimpleMatch '三点译法说明' | ForEach-Object { $_.Line.Trim() }; $c | Select-String -SimpleMatch '两条均按' | ForEach-Object { $_.Line.Trim() }", "workdir": "F:\\Workspaces\\chinese-academic-writing-skill", "max_output_tokens": 8000}
